name: semantic-baseline-refreeze-after-authorized-stage-function-correction-2026-09-11
description: User-authorized semantic correction: third-party certification remains S5 trust-qualified but may be reused by S1/S2/S6 according to actual stage function, and purchase-conditioned incentives such as buy-and-get qualify under the existing S6 CTA fields while ordinary gift lists do not. This is not a claim of no semantic change. The existing baseline, GT, thresholds, model routes, and promotion eligibility remain unchanged; legacy artifact qualification, gap, and promotion statuses are not migrated, and promotion_eligible stays false.
